# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Read applicable statutes.
3. For additional assistance refer to the “Workplace Accident Reports Explained: For Agencies, Businesses, Schools, and Other Public Entities” on the [NYSIF website](https://www.nysif.com/NYSForms/WCBForms%20EN.pdf).
4. Before submitting a new reportable workplace accident or injury to your reportable incident portal, make sure you read this [flowchart](https://nysif.com/documentation/flowchart.pdf).
5. If the injured employee is entitled to benefits under [PDL](https://nysif.com/documentation/pregnancyHandbook.pdf), refer to the [Pregnancy Handbook](https://nysif.com/documentation/pregnancyHandbook.pdf) to determine the correct applicable benefits policy code.
